palpation.zh: 沿肩胛冈向外侧触摸至肩部最高、最外侧的骨性平台；三角肌中束起点
palpation.en: Follow the spine of the scapula laterally to the bony shelf at the top of the shoulder; origin of middle deltoid

palpation.zh: 锁骨外侧 1/3 下方、三角肌胸大肌间沟深处可触及的骨性突起；胸小肌、肱二头肌短头、喙肱肌附着
palpation.en: Deep in the deltopectoral groove, below the lateral third of the clavicle; attachment of pectoralis minor, short head of biceps and coracobrachialis

palpation.zh: 约平 T7–T8，沿肩胛骨内侧缘向下触及的尖端；评估肩胛骨上回旋与翼状肩胛
palpation.en: Roughly at T7–T8; follow the medial border down to its tip; used to assess scapular upward rotation and winging

palpation.zh: 约平 T2，斜方肌下方；肩胛提肌附着
palpation.en: About T2, deep to trapezius; insertion of levator scapulae

palpation.zh: 肩峰外侧缘下方 2–3 cm、三角肌深面的骨性隆起；冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌止点
palpation.en: 2–3 cm below the lateral acromion, deep to deltoid; insertion of supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor

palpation.zh: 沿锁骨向外侧至其与肩峰相接处的小台阶；肩锁关节
palpation.en: Follow the clavicle laterally to the small step where it meets the acromion; acromioclavicular joint

palpation.zh: 两侧锁骨内侧端之间、胸骨柄上缘的凹陷
palpation.en: The dip at the top of the manubrium between the medial ends of the clavicles

palpation.zh: 颈根部最突出的棘突，颈部屈伸时 C7 随之滑动而 T1 不动；斜方肌、菱形肌起点
palpation.en: The most prominent spinous process at the base of the neck; moves with neck flexion while T1 stays still; origin of trapezius and rhomboids

palpation.zh: 沿第12肋向内侧触及的棘突；胸腰交界
palpation.en: Reached by following the 12th rib medially; thoracolumbar junction

palpation.zh: T12 棘突下一个棘突
palpation.en: The spinous process below T12

palpation.zh: 约平脐上缘水平
palpation.en: About level with the upper umbilicus

palpation.zh: 两侧髂嵴最高点连线（Tuffier 线）通过 L4 棘突或 L4–L5 间隙；腰椎穿刺与腰椎节段定位标志
palpation.en: The line joining the highest points of the iliac crests (Tuffier's line) crosses the L4 spinous process or L4–L5 space; used to count lumbar levels

palpation.zh: L4 棘突下一个，位于两侧髂后上棘连线稍上方
palpation.en: Next below L4; just above the line joining the PSISs

palpation.zh: 竖脊肌外侧、髂嵴上方的游离肋尖；腰方肌、腹内斜肌附着
palpation.en: The free tip lateral to erector spinae above the iliac crest; attachment of quadratus lumborum and internal oblique

palpation.zh: 胸骨体下端、肋弓夹角处的小突起；腹直肌附着
palpation.en: Small projection at the lower end of the sternum between the costal margins; attachment of rectus abdominis

palpation.zh: 髂嵴向前的终点，仰卧位在髋前外侧最前突的骨点；缝匠肌、阔筋膜张肌起点，腹股沟韧带外侧附着
palpation.en: The anterior end of the iliac crest, the most forward bony point at the front of the hip; origin of sartorius and tensor fasciae latae; lateral attachment of the inguinal ligament

palpation.zh: 骶骨两侧"腰窝"（Venus 窝）处的骨性隆起，约平 S2；骶髂关节定位
palpation.en: The bony bump at the "dimple" on each side of the sacrum, about S2; landmark for the sacroiliac joint

palpation.zh: 双手叉腰时手掌下的骨性边缘；两侧最高点连线约平 L4
palpation.en: The bony rim under the hands when resting them on the hips; the line between both highest points is about L4

palpation.zh: 髋外侧最宽处的骨性隆起；臀中肌、臀小肌及髋深层外旋肌止点，髂胫束滑过其表面
palpation.en: The widest bony point on the outer hip; insertion of gluteus medius/minimus and the deep rotators; the iliotibial tract glides over it

palpation.zh: 坐位时承重的骨点，臀大肌下缘深面；腘绳肌共同起点
palpation.en: The weight-bearing point when sitting, deep to the lower edge of gluteus maximus; common origin of the hamstrings

palpation.zh: 膝前皮下的圆形骨；股四头肌腱止于其上缘，髌韧带起于其下极
palpation.en: The round bone under the skin at the front of the knee; quadriceps tendon attaches above, patellar ligament below

palpation.zh: 髌骨下方约 3 cm、胫骨前方的骨性隆起；髌韧带止点（股四头肌）
palpation.en: About 3 cm below the patella at the front of the tibia; insertion of the patellar ligament (quadriceps)

palpation.zh: 胫骨粗隆外侧约 2–3 cm、关节线下方的骨性隆起；髂胫束止点
palpation.en: 2–3 cm lateral to the tibial tuberosity just below the joint line; insertion of the iliotibial tract

palpation.zh: 膝外侧关节线上方的骨性隆起；外侧副韧带、腘肌起点
palpation.en: Bony prominence above the lateral joint line; origin of the lateral collateral ligament and popliteus

palpation.zh: 膝内侧关节线上方的骨性隆起；内侧副韧带起点
palpation.en: Bony prominence above the medial joint line; origin of the medial collateral ligament

palpation.zh: 膝外侧关节线下方约 2 cm 的圆形骨点；股二头肌腱与外侧副韧带止点，腓总神经在其后下方绕过
palpation.en: Round bony point about 2 cm below the lateral joint line; insertion of biceps femoris and the lateral collateral ligament; the common fibular nerve wraps behind and below it

note.zh: 含肩肱节律：30° 后肩胛上回旋与盂肱运动按 1:2 分担
note.en: Includes scapulohumeral rhythm: beyond 30 degrees the scapula and glenohumeral joint share the motion 1:2

note.zh: 正值为前屈，负值为后伸；肩胛节律同外展
note.en: Positive = flexion, negative = extension; same scapular rhythm as abduction

note.zh: 上臂自然下垂位，正值为内旋，负值为外旋
note.en: Arm at the side; positive = internal, negative = external rotation

note.zh: 正值为屈，负值为伸（骨盆固定）
正值为外展，负值为内收
0° = 伸直。屈膝时髌骨沿股骨髁下滑；滑块往回拉即为伸膝（股四头肌主动，腘绳肌拮抗）
note.en: 0 = straight. The patella glides down the femoral condyles; moving back is extension (quadriceps active, hamstrings antagonist)

note.zh: 角度按 L5…L1 与胸廓分摊；正值为前屈，负值为后伸
note.en: The angle is shared between L5...L1 and the thorax; positive = flexion, negative = extension

note.zh: 正值为向右侧屈，负值为向左侧屈
note.en: Positive = bend to the right, negative = to the left

note.zh: 正值为向右旋转，负值为向左旋转；腰椎旋转范围小，主要发生在胸段
note.en: Positive = rotate right, negative = left; lumbar rotation is small, most of it happens in the thoracic spine
